blocks.text: One addition to Ashley's note, which I should have made in my own: the copies should be of records as they were kept at the time, and nothing should be recreated, retyped, or updated now, even where a newer version would be easier to read. A document prepared after the fact carries little weight if the date of first use is ever questioned, and an original with a visible date, however rough it looks, is worth more to {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} than a clean version without one.
Nothing else in our plan changes, and the end of next week remains the date we are working to for both of Ashley's questions.
Once Kelly has the records and the updated product description, she will complete her review of the full search, and I will then write to you to arrange a time to go through our conclusions together.
